name: aiden_app_connection_capabilities_v1
description: End-to-end coverage for Aiden App capabilities forwarded through an environment bridge into a benchmark task agent. Requires a real iOS or Android phone with the Aiden App connected and permissions granted.

tasks.description_for_judge: Without inspecting the screen or invoking a tool, report the connected iPhone's system name, system version, locale, time zone, and battery state from the forwarded Aiden App environment context. Values must be concrete and mutually consistent; missing fields must be identified rather than invented.

setup.prompt: 请回到 Aiden App，并停留在连接状态正常的首页；如果已经在该页面则不要进行其他操作。

tasks.prompt: 不要查看屏幕，也不要操作手机。请根据当前已连接手机提供的环境信息，告诉我系统名称与版本、区域语言、时区和电池状态；没有提供的字段请明确说未知，不要猜测。

rubric.check: The response identifies the connected system as iOS and reports concrete system version, locale, time zone, and battery facts when present in the runtime context.
The response marks unavailable environment fields as unknown instead of inventing values.
The trace contains no tool calls; the answer is derived from the Aiden App environment context forwarded through the environment bridge.

tasks.description_for_judge: Without inspecting the screen or invoking a tool, report the connected Android phone's system name, system version, locale, time zone, and battery state from the forwarded Aiden App environment context. Values must be concrete and mutually consistent; missing fields must be identified rather than invented.

setup.prompt: 请回到 Aiden App，并停留在连接状态正常的首页；如果已经在该页面则不要进行其他操作。

tasks.prompt: 不要查看屏幕，也不要操作手机。请根据当前已连接手机提供的环境信息，告诉我系统名称与版本、区域语言、时区和电池状态；没有提供的字段请明确说未知，不要猜测。

rubric.check: The response identifies the connected system as Android and reports concrete system version, locale, time zone, and battery facts when present in the runtime context.
The response marks unavailable environment fields as unknown instead of inventing values.
The trace contains no tool calls; the answer is derived from the Aiden App environment context forwarded through the environment bridge.

tasks.description_for_judge: Open the phone's default browser through the semantic open_app fast path provided by the connected Aiden App. The trace must not fall back to visible app search or touch navigation.

setup.prompt: 请回到 Aiden App，并停留在连接状态正常的首页；如果已经在该页面则不要进行其他操作。

tasks.prompt: 请直接打开这台手机的默认浏览器。

rubric.check: The trace contains open_app with app=browser and a successful Phone Bridge result.
The post-screenshot shows the phone's browser without an Aiden App or OS error.
The trace does not use search_launch_app or touch_gesture to find the browser.

tasks.description_for_judge: Open the exact HTTPS URL through the connected Aiden App's URL capability, without manually launching or navigating a browser.

setup.prompt: 请回到 Aiden App，并停留在连接状态正常的首页；如果已经在该页面则不要进行其他操作。

rubric.check: The trace contains open_url with exactly https://example.com/ and a successful Phone Bridge result.
The post-screenshot shows a browser handling example.com; network loading failure is acceptable, but an Aiden App command error is not.
The trace does not manually open a browser, type the URL, or use touch navigation.

tasks.description_for_judge: Read and preserve the original system clipboard, write a benchmark marker, read it back exactly, restore the original value (including an empty string), and verify the restoration. All clipboard operations must use the connected Aiden App capability.

setup.prompt: 请回到 Aiden App，并停留在连接状态正常的首页；如果已经在该页面则不要进行其他操作。

tasks.prompt: 请先记住手机当前剪贴板的原始文本；把它临时改成「AIDEN_BRIDGE_CLIPBOARD_V1」，读回并确认完全一致；最后恢复最初的文本，再读回确认已经恢复。即使原始文本为空也必须恢复为空。

rubric.check: The first bridge_clipboard call reads the original clipboard before any write.
The Agent writes AIDEN_BRIDGE_CLIPBOARD_V1 and then reads back the same exact value.
The Agent writes the value returned by the first read back to the clipboard, including an explicit empty string when appropriate, and performs a final read that confirms restoration.
No enter_text, quick_action, or touch-based copy/paste workaround is used.

tasks.description_for_judge: Exercise calendar create, structured query, and delete over the forwarded Aiden App connection, using the returned event_id for cleanup. Remove stale events with the same benchmark title before creating the test event and leave no matching event behind.

setup.prompt: 请回到 Aiden App，并停留在连接状态正常的首页；如果已经在该页面则不要进行其他操作。

tasks.prompt: 请对系统日历做一次可回滚验证。先查询 2037-11-18T00:00:00+08:00 到 2037-11-19T00:00:00+08:00，并删除遗留的同名事件「AIDEN_BRIDGE_CALENDAR_V1」。然后创建事件：标题「AIDEN_BRIDGE_CALENDAR_V1」，开始 2037-11-18T14:00:00+08:00，结束 2037-11-18T14:30:00+08:00，地点「Bridge Lab」，备注「temporary benchmark event」，提前 5 分钟提醒。再次查询并确认所有字段正确，最后使用本次创建返回的事件 ID 删除它，并查询确认不再存在。

rubric.check: The Agent queries the target range first and deletes any pre-existing events titled AIDEN_BRIDGE_CALENDAR_V1 before creating a new one.
bridge_calendar creates the event with the exact requested title, RFC3339 times, location, notes, and five-minute alarm.
A later bridge_calendar query returns the created event and the Agent checks its structured fields.
The Agent deletes using the event_id returned by this run's create/query result and a final query confirms no matching event remains.

tasks.description_for_judge: Query the provisioned Aiden Benchmark Fixture contact, update it using its returned contact_id, verify the temporary structured values, then restore every baseline field using the same contact_id and verify restoration. The suite deliberately does not create contacts because the Aiden App API has no contact-delete cleanup operation.

setup.prompt: 请回到 Aiden App，并停留在连接状态正常的首页；如果已经在该页面则不要进行其他操作。

tasks.prompt: 请验证通讯录中的专用测试联系人「Aiden Benchmark Fixture」。先查询它并取得联系人 ID；它的基线数据应为手机号 +1 202-555-0199、邮箱 benchmark-contact@example.com、组织 Aiden Baseline、备注 managed benchmark fixture。保持姓名、手机号、邮箱和备注不变，使用查到的 ID 将组织临时改为 Aiden Round Trip，再查询确认。随后使用同一个 ID 把全部字段恢复到上述基线值，最后再次查询确认已经完全恢复。若找不到唯一的测试联系人，请停止并说明夹具缺失，不要新建联系人。

rubric.check: The Agent queries Aiden Benchmark Fixture, obtains exactly one fixture and uses its returned contact_id rather than inventing an ID.
The Agent updates the fixture organization to Aiden Round Trip while preserving every other baseline field, then queries and verifies it.
The Agent updates the same contact_id back to all baseline fields and a final query confirms complete restoration.
The Agent does not create a new contact when the provisioned fixture is missing or ambiguous.

tasks.description_for_judge: Send an immediate local notification with exact structured fields through the connected Aiden App and report the returned notification identifier.

setup.prompt: 请回到 Aiden App，并停留在连接状态正常的首页；如果已经在该页面则不要进行其他操作。

tasks.prompt: 请立即发送一条本地通知：标题「AIDEN_BRIDGE_NOTIFICATION_V1」，正文「forwarded app connection verified」，不播放声音，角标数字设为 1。完成后告诉我返回的通知 ID。

rubric.check: bridge_notification is called with action=send, the exact title/body, sound=false, badge=1, and no schedule_at value.
The Phone Bridge call succeeds and the final response reports the notification_id returned by the Aiden App.
The trace does not navigate notification settings or use touch controls.
